sim-aethir.label: SIM-AETHIR (Cloud Host reward epochs)
sim-aethir.imitates: Aethir-style reward flow: the network recognises one reward obligation per epoch for a Cloud Host, pays each epoch in full after it closes, and applies QoS/uptime adjustments as signed corrections before payment.

sim-gpunet.label: SIM-GPUNET (marketplace job invoices)
sim-gpunet.imitates: GPU.net-style marketplace flow: one invoice per rendered job, partial settlements as jobs stream, disputes that cancel an invoice, and a chargeback that reverses an already-paid settlement.
